scopeBasis.macos: Foliole 0.7.16 blocks the LAN sync compressed-response vulnerability in the bundled Node runtime and moves older library upgrades off the main thread in the macOS app, so the macOS package is required.
scopeBasis.windows: Foliole 0.7.16 blocks the LAN sync compressed-response vulnerability and fixes the long unresponsive library upgrade reported on Windows, verified on the Windows development machine, so the Windows package and direct installer are required.
scopeBasis.linux: Foliole 0.7.16 changes the shared Electron runtime security fix, library upgrade path and desktop sync protocol used by Linux Experimental, so the Linux Experimental package is required.
